question: Among patients born after 1970 who had laboratory tests in 1984, identify those with abnormal lactate dehydrogenase (LDH ≥ 500) or abnormal fibrinogen (FG ≤ 150 or FG ≥ 450). For these patients, compute the percentage change in their total cholesterol (T-CHO) from November to December 1984.

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT P.XCL_058
  FROM Patient AS P
  INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.XCL_058 = L.XCL_014
  WHERE P.XCL_060 > '1970-12-31'
    AND L.XCL_015 LIKE '1984-%'
    AND (L.XCL_018 >= 500 OR L.XCL_036 <= 150 OR L.XCL_036 >= 450)
),
cholesterol AS (
  SELECT
    L.XCL_014,
    SUM(CASE WHEN L.XCL_015 LIKE '1984-11-%' THEN L.XCL_026 ELSE 0 END) AS nov_cho,
    SUM(CASE WHEN L.XCL_015 LIKE '1984-12-%' THEN L.XCL_026 ELSE 0 END) AS dec_cho
  FROM Laboratory AS L
  WHERE L.XCL_014 IN (SELECT XCL_058 FROM qualifying)
    AND L.XCL_015 LIKE '1984-%'
  GROUP BY L.XCL_014
)
SELECT
  C.XCL_014,
  CAST((C.dec_cho - C.nov_cho) AS REAL) / C.nov_cho * 100 AS pct_change
FROM cholesterol AS C
WHERE C.nov_cho > 0 AND C.dec_cho > 0

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT P.XCL_058
  FROM Patient AS P
  INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.XCL_058 = L.XCL_014
  WHERE P.XCL_060 > '1970-12-31'
    AND L.XCL_015 LIKE '1984-%'
    AND (L.XCL_018 >= 500 OR L.XCL_036 <= 150 OR L.XCL_036 >= 450)
),
cholesterol AS (
  SELECT
    L.XCL_014,
    SUM(CASE WHEN L.XCL_015 LIKE '1984-11-%' THEN L.XCL_026 ELSE 0 END) AS nov_cho,
    SUM(CASE WHEN L.XCL_015 LIKE '1984-12-%' THEN L.XCL_026 ELSE 0 END) AS dec_cho
  FROM Laboratory AS L
  WHERE L.XCL_014 IN (SELECT XCL_058 FROM qualifying)
    AND L.XCL_015 LIKE '1984-%'
  GROUP BY L.XCL_014
)
SELECT
  C.XCL_014,
  CAST((C.dec_cho - C.nov_cho) AS REAL) / C.nov_cho * 100 AS pct_change
FROM cholesterol AS C
WHERE C.nov_cho > 0 AND C.dec_cho > 0

    AND L.XCL_015 LIKE '1984-%'

  WHERE L.XCL_014 IN (SELECT XCL_058 FROM qualifying)
    AND L.XCL_015 LIKE '1984-%'
  GROUP BY L.XCL_014

SELECT
    p.XCL_058 AS patient_id,
    (
        (
            SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', l.XCL_015) = '12' THEN l.XCL_020 END)
            FROM Laboratory l
            WHERE l.XCL_014 = p.XCL_058
              AND strftime('%Y', l.XCL_015) = '1984'
        )
        -
        (
            SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', l.XCL_015) = '11' THEN l.XCL_020 END)
            FROM Laboratory l
            WHERE l.XCL_014 = p.XCL_058
              AND strftime('%Y', l.XCL_015) = '1984'
        )
    ) * 100.0 /
    (
        SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', l.XCL_015) = '11' THEN l.XCL_020 END)
        FROM Laboratory l
        WHERE l.XCL_014 = p.XCL_058
          AND strftime('%Y', l.XCL_015) = '1984'
    ) AS pct_change_tcho
FROM Patient p
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.XCL_060) > '1970'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory l
      WHERE l.XCL_014 = p.XCL_058
        AND strftime('%Y', l.XCL_015) = '1984'
        AND (
            l.XCL_021 >= 500
            OR l.XCL_022 <= 150
            OR l.XCL_022 >= 450
        )
  )
